title: The Orchard of Port Alder
author: Rosalind Okafor
blurb: Jonah Halloran, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
